content.rendered:
Dr. Angelina Tiah – Group Managing Director & CEO

Dr. Angelina Tiah earned her Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree from the University of Malaya, focusing on research in cellular therapy. Prior to that, she completed her Bachelor of Science in Chemistry and Biology from Campbell University, US. She is certified in aseptic surgical skills by the Covidien Clinical Institute Shanghai and holds an APC in complementary Medicine. Dr. Angelina has actively contributed to professional development and clinical education in her previous roles. She led product training for local distributors, provided continuous medical education for healthcare professionals, and conducted live surgery and “Train the Trainer” workshops for doctors internationally. To date, she has co-authored several publications on cellular therapy for conditions such as retinitis pigmentosa, stroke, autism, chronic wound, immunology and more.

Exposure:

  • Executive Director and CEO of 23 Century International Group of Companies
  • Executive Director and Founder of cGMP Beike 23 Century International Stem Cell Laboratory
  • Executive Director and Founder of Nax Health
  • Master Franchisor and IP owner of Facilitas Healthcare
  • MSCM Complementary Practitioner (Malaysia APC-Mind Body and Soul)
  • Senior leadership in Multi National Companies (Healthcare)
  • Certified Speaker and Trainer by Malaysia HRDF (Human Resource Development Fund), FORUM and Ken Blanchard
